s2.ptxt: Apply Denso No. 50 grease to the entire circumference of the lip of the rear wiper motor grommet.

atten4.ptxt: The grease must fill the groove of the lip without blocking the hole.

s2.ptxt: Install the rear wiper motor grommet.
Insert the shaft of the rear wiper motor assembly into the grommet.
Install the rear wiper motor assembly with the 3 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly

s2.ptxt: Stop the rear wiper motor assembly at the automatic stop position.
Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the rear wiper arm & blade assembly with the rear wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the rear wiper arm nut.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Install the rear wiper arm head cap.

atten3.ptxt: Push it in until it clicks.

s2.ptxt: Operate the rear wiper while applying water or washer fluid to the glass, and check the wiping condition of the blade and that it does not interfere with the body.

s-1.ptxt: Install Back Door Trim Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Engage the 11 clips to install the back door trim panel assembly.
Engage the 4 claws to install the back door inside handle.

s-1.ptxt: Install Back Door Side Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the clips and claws to install the back door side garnish LH.
Align the guide position, and engage the 2 claws to install the package tray trim garnish hook.
Engage the pin of the package tray trim garnish hook.

s-1.ptxt: Install Back Door Side Garnish RH

atten4.ptxt: Install the RH side using the same procedure as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Back Door Trim Panel Assembly Upper
